why: A full ceasefire taking effect makes an unguaranteed (Minsk-style) ceasefire more likely. It is not treated as a necessary first step, however, because that scenario could also come about without it, through a ceasefire reached in 2027 or later.

A ceasefire taking effect and an announced reopening of the strait raise the chance of an end to the war and full reopening. The same announcements could also lead to an incomplete reopening with restrictions on shipping still in place, however, so they are not treated as a necessary first step.

An officially announced resumption of strikes makes the external variable of the United States resuming large-scale strikes more likely; that variable requires at least three consecutive days of strikes on Iran's mainland. Brief strikes alone could resolve this forecast yes, so the two are not treated as the same event.
This forecast is North Korea's seventh nuclear test, which already appears as a cell in the chain of links.
This forecast asks whether Brent will close the year below $90 a barrel, so it concerns the oil price itself. A lower probability means oil prices are more likely to stay high at year-end.
Restoring military communication lines is one of three conditions for managed coexistence. If the lines are not restored by the end of 2026, managed coexistence becomes less likely.

Resuming family reunions or checks on whether separated relatives are alive is one of three conditions for managed coexistence. If neither resumes by the end of June 2027, managed coexistence becomes less likely.
Family reunions or large-scale checks on whether relatives are alive by the end of 2028 would meet one of the three conditions for managed coexistence, making that scenario more likely.

The wording of this forecast matches the definition of nuclear dominoes: South Korea or Japan formalizing, by the end of 2030, a decision to develop nuclear weapons, withdrawal from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty, or abandonment of its non-nuclear principles.

The wording of this forecast matches the definition of sudden upheaval: a change of North Korea's supreme leader, or an armed clash on the Korean Peninsula that kills 100 or more people, by the end of 2030.

A U.S.-North Korean agreement on a freeze or sanctions relief, with military communication lines and reunions of separated families still not resumed, is a deal that fails to meet the conditions for managed coexistence, and so is nearly the same event as a deal without South Korea.

Chinese inspections or detentions of Taiwanese ships make gray-zone escalation more likely. They are not treated as the same event, however, because gray-zone escalation is defined by measures around Taiwan's main island, while measures around outlying islands such as Kinmen and Matsu count only as warning signs.
This forecast is the same event as the Taiwan issue's external variable of a Kuomintang candidate winning the January 2028 presidential election.
This forecast is a full Russia-Ukraine ceasefire holding for 30 days, which already appears as a cell in the chain of links.
The Ukrainian government signing away occupied territory is one of two paths to peace on Russia's terms, so it makes that scenario more likely.

Deploying a multinational force in Ukraine raises the chance of a guaranteed (Korean-style) ceasefire, in which Western troops guarantee the truce. It is not treated as a necessary step, because that scenario could also come about through a deployment after 2027.

The event in this forecast matches a nuclear-armed Iran, but its deadline is earlier: the end of 2027. So it is linked not as the same event but as a signal that makes a nuclear-armed Iran more likely.
If there is no blockade of Taiwan's ports before the January 2028 presidential election, the chance of a blockade or quarantine by the end of 2030 falls accordingly.

Signing a phased agreement raises the chance of an end to the war and full reopening. It is not treated as a necessary first step, however, because if shipping restrictions return after the signing, the result is an incomplete reopening.

If North Korea's official media state explicitly that AI has been applied to the country's nuclear command system, one of the two paths to the external variable of fewer human decision points and delegated authority is met.

A phased agreement that holds for 90 days or more makes an end to the war and full reopening much more likely. That scenario requires six months without shipping restrictions, however, so the two are not treated as the same event.

The definition of gray-zone escalation explicitly lists boarding inspections and navigation controls in the waters around outlying islands such as Kinmen and Matsu as warning signs, so this forecast makes gray-zone escalation more likely.

If the Security Consultative Meeting communiqué states that U.S. Forces Korea will be kept at 28,500 troops, the external variable of a substantive U.S. retreat (a formal weakening of extended deterrence or cuts to U.S. Forces Korea without compensating measures) becomes less likely.

If U.S. Forces Korea falls below 28,500 troops, the external variable of a substantive U.S. retreat (a formal weakening of extended deterrence or cuts to U.S. Forces Korea without compensating measures) becomes more likely.

If Poland's 2027 defense budget is set at 4.5 percent of GDP or more, a major part of European defense spending is fixed at a high level, so this forecast directly covers part of European defense spending.
Deaths on NATO territory caused by Russian or Belarusian sabotage would complete one of two paths to the scenario of a deadly incident followed by a patch-up.

A renewed violation of Polish airspace by Russian or Belarusian manned aircraft is not in itself a deadly incident followed by a patch-up, but that scenario is met if the intruding aircraft is shot down, so the violation makes it more likely.

Restoring a hotline or reaching an agreement to prevent accidental clashes puts in place one of the risk-reduction mechanisms (a hotline, notification of exercises, an agreement to prevent accidental clashes) that the lower-tensions scenario requires, making that scenario more likely.
This forecast is the extension or broadening of General License 135 for Russian diesel, which already appears as a cell in the chain of links.

If the International Atomic Energy Agency verifies on site the location and quantity of Iran's stockpile of 60 percent enriched uranium, the nuclear material comes under monitoring, making a nuclear-armed Iran less likely.
If even part of Iran's uranium enriched to 20 percent or more is shipped out of the country, less material usable for nuclear weapons remains, making a nuclear-armed Iran less likely.

A U.S. announcement lifting the naval blockade or easing it in stages raises the chance of an end to the war and full reopening. Because a phased easing alone could resolve this forecast, it is not treated as a necessary first step.

Senate passage of a war powers resolution makes the external variable of congressional restraint on the war more likely. That variable is met through House passage and the president's signature, or through appropriations.
When European gas prices top €100 per megawatt-hour, Europe competes with Asia for the same LNG cargoes, pushing Asian LNG prices up.

If Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline, loadings at Yanbu, or shipping through Bab el-Mandeb stop for seven days or more, the external variable of Hormuz bypass routes being cut off becomes more likely.
If Germany increases its budget for military aid to Ukraine, spending that counts as defense spending under NATO's definition rises, adding to European defense spending.

If the communiqué of the 58th Security Consultative Meeting states that U.S. Forces Korea will stay at its current level, the external variable of a substantive U.S. retreat (a formal weakening of extended deterrence or cuts to U.S. Forces Korea without compensating measures) becomes less likely.

A U.S.-North Korean summit agreement that leaves out South Korea and contains no inter-Korean provisions is the core form of a deal without South Korea, making that scenario more likely. Whether it includes a freeze or sanctions relief is left open, so it is not treated as the same event.
